notes.title: DOGFIGHT [Operation Lone Wolf Update #25]
notes.content:
[h1]Trailer:[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtkdhJVnOZ0&feature=youtu.be
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33474550/b6ea240c4801283aee993acba34e38b1a6d0f0c9.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33474550/1c159f24c7320d90ffc28b0359d8ffcd97d179da.jpg[/img]
[h1]Dogfight[/h1]
I wanted to add something completely different, so here it is. Dogfight. Fight against AI controlled enemies to earn credits and increase your highscore. I've added highscore leaderboards to Dogfight as well, so you can compete with other players to get in the top 10. With the credits you earn you can buy or upgrade planes.
It is still in early development, more content like new planes, maps, modes etc. will be added over time. Right now there are two planes, one map and one mode available to play.

Hi! This next update adds some improvements and a new gamemode to the game. I also have made some progress on the first single player mission. 

[h1]Details[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Gamemode: Realistic
In this gamemode your HUD is disabled, there are no hitmarkers, no killfeed, and recoil is increased to give it a more realistic feel.

[*]Killing Bots now gives you XP and money to unlock new weapons in multiplayer, and level up your character. 

[*]Killcams are added to PvE, so you know where you got shot from (not available in all gamemodes, for example not in the new Realistic gamemode).

[*]Added some new vegetation to the Desert map (cactuses).

[*]Fixed a bug where Bots would ignore you when you where extremely close to them.
[/list]
I will try to finish the first mission soon, but I also want to make sure to make it as good as possible. Stay tuned!
